channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Mike Dunleavy | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Mike Dunleavy from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Mike Dunleavy, Joe Lacob, Jimmy Butler, Dennis Schroeder
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“I've also seen that Mike Dunleavy and Joe Lacob have gotten a lot of criticism for their lack of risk taking over the last few years, playing it for the post-Steph era. And listen, there's always going to be backlash when you're not winning. It happens to everyone. That's just what comes with the territory. But I don't think going to trade for Jimmy Butler would be considered lack of taking risks, especially signing him to a two-year $121 million extension. I don't think that would be considered a lack of taking risk. I also don't believe that trading for Dennis Schroeder, trying to make something happen, is a lack of taking risk.”

Draymond Green on Mike Dunleavy, Joe Lacob, Jimmy Butler, Dennis Schroeder, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Chris Kaman on Mike Dunleavy, Terry Stotts
item.description:
Jason Quick:Chris Kaman:

“I just told Terry (Stotts) he is the first coach I haven't hated at the end of the season since Mike Dunleavy. Long time.”

Chris Kaman on Mike Dunleavy, Terry Stotts, May 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @jwquick.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Mike Dunleavy, Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Taj Gibson
item.description:
“We're not starting from scratch... We still have Noah and Derrick and (Mike) Dunleavy and Taj Gibson and (Carlos) Boozer.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Mike Dunleavy, Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Taj Gibson, Jan 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @stevekylerNBA.
